example.en: The tourist association is drumming up support for the new museum.

items.meaning_da: gøre meget væsen af noget

example.en: The firm made a big fuss about its new product.

items.meaning_da: have den ledende rolle

example.en: With two degrees she has more than one string to her bow.

example.en: She can read her husband like a book.

example.en: She doesn't mince her words when she criticises the government.

items.literal: be in the pocket of someone
items.meaning_da: være afhængig af og styret af nogen

items.meaning_da: være sikker på noget

items.meaning_da: man kan ikke tage sine penge med i graven

example.en: Spend the money on something nice – you can't take it with you.
